**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

Commerce One imposes no non-compete or field-of-use covenant on Corio. The restrictions binding us are confined to protecting Commerce One's IP (§2.7 no reverse engineering; §12 no distribution of Source Code) and post-term trademark use (§6.1) — none limits the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy, build or resell. Territory (§1.11) and Corio Market Segment (§1.3) are scope-of-grant limits rather than restrictive covenants (and §1.3 lets us keep customers that grow or are acquired past the revenue threshold), all licences are nonexclusive, Exhibit D cooperation is expressly non-binding, and §13.6 affirmatively preserves independent development. No redline proposed.
